hints.title: Diagonal Corner Pair Matching
hints.text: Store all point coordinates in a lookup collection so existence queries take constant time.

hints.title: Axis-Aligned Coordinate Test
hints.text: Treat every pair of points with differing x and y coordinates as potential opposite diagonal vertices of an axis-aligned rectangle.

hints.title: Hash Set Lookup Minimization
hints.text: For points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), verify if (x1, y2) and (x2, y1) exist in the lookup set. If both exist, calculate abs(x1 - x2) * abs(y1 - y2) and minimize over all valid pairs.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 4-point subsets takes O(N^4) operations, which times out for N = 500.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking pairs of diagonal endpoints and doing O(1) set membership tests lowers complexity to O(N^2) with O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should observe that fixing two diagonal points uniquely determines the coordinates of the other two points for axis-aligned rectangles.
complexity.notes: Condition x1 != x2 and y1 != y2 ensures the degenerate zero-area line segments are ignored.
